piezas.titulo: Speaking practice: Transport and getting around
texto: Integrated conversation: checking routes at the ticket office or bus stop. When you ask a driver or conductor («รถคันนี้ไปสถานีรถไฟไหมครับ/คะ»), pay attention to their confirmation and ask whether you need to change («ต้องเปลี่ยนรถไหมครับ/คะ»). Practise answering with confidence.
